cohort: 100 mothers who underwent PPIUCD insertion after delivery (50 vaginal, 50 cesarean) at SKMCH, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India between January 2022 and December 2022.
finding: PPIUCD insertion was found to be a safe and effective method of contraception after both vaginal and cesarean delivery, with low rates of complications.
mod_finding: Both vaginal and cesarean delivery groups had similarly low rates of complications following PPIUCD insertion.
